welcome:
Welcome to Synergix, {name}! 🧠🔥

We are the first decentralized collective intelligence on BNB Greenfield.
Every contribution you make is immortalized on the blockchain and strengthens a network that grows with you. 🌐

Your knowledge has real value. Share it and be part of something greater. 🚀
welcome_back:
🌟 Welcome back, {name}!

Synergix has been waiting for you. The network has grown since your last visit and your legacy remains intact.

🔥 Ready to keep immortalizing wisdom?
memory_empty: 🧠 You haven't immortalized any wisdom on the network yet. 🔥 Tap Contribute and leave your first eternal mark.
contribution_mode: 🎯 Contribution mode activated Write your idea, reflection or knowledge. It will be recorded forever on the Synergix network. 💡 Minimum 20 characters. ✨ Be original, be deep, be eternal.
contribution_received: Received! Your wisdom is being processed and immortalized. 🔗

contribution_too_short:
✂️ Your contribution is too short. It needs at least 20 characters.

💡 Develop your idea further. Every word counts in eternity.
contribution_duplicate:
🔄 This wisdom already exists on the network.

💡 Try a unique and original perspective!

challenge_broadcast: 🎯 New Weekly Challenge! 📝 {challenge_description} 💎 All related contributions receive +5 bonus points. 🔥 Participate now and leave your mark!
residual_notify:
💫 Your wisdom was just used to enlighten another mind!

+1 royalty point added to your eternal legacy.

⚡ Synergix is processing too much wisdom right now.

🔄 Try again in a few seconds.
